question: L-Dopa is combined with carbidopa in the treatment of parkinsonism to -

options.opc: Increase the dose of levodopa required
options.opd: Inhibit conversion of levodopa to dopamine in the CNS

analysis: Carbidopa is combined with L-Dopa in the treatment of parkinsonism to inhibit the peripheral conversion of levodopa to dopamine, allowing more levodopa to reach the brain and be converted to dopamine centrally. This helps to increase the efficacy of levodopa and reduce peripheral side effects.
